boundaries: Equipment values and skill membership are a shared fixed input, not an independent live validation of MHDB provenance or game version.
No product module, product formula, canonical technique database, or observed damage value is used to calculate expected numbers.
Expected numbers are computed before the observation file is read.
All three contacts use the weapon maximum green sharpness; depletion is outside this fixture.
Affinity expectation is linear probability weighting, not a promise of a particular critical/noncritical game roll.
Normal and maximum channels are compared to the same oracle because the only relevant attack skill is unconditional Critical Eye Lv1.
The fixture has no element and no equipment granting the recorded unrelated state toggles; no extra damage contribution is inferred from those toggles.
No DPS is derived because no verified duration is supplied.
Rounded display, actual health decrement, actual target hitzone, current game version, and complete legal equipment builds remain unverified.
